title: Billing Office Ruling: Discount Base of the Rental Vehicle Coordination Repair-Customer Discount
content:
**Ruling.** On a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network customer-pay repair, the discount base, being the amount of the time charge on which the repair-customer discount credit is given, is chosen from the time charge entries: where a time charge stands on a corrected invoice, the discount base is that corrected time charge; where no corrected time charge stands but billing-error credits stand on the rental, it is the time charge posted on the final invoice less those billing-error credits; otherwise it is the time charge posted on the final invoice.

## Entries read

- The customer's uncovered-days charge on a **corrected** invoice of the rental (the corrected time charge).
- The customer's uncovered-days charge on the **final** invoice of the rental (the final time charge).
- Every customer credit with reason billing error on the rental.

## Choice table

| Corrected time charge stands | Billing-error credits stand | Discount base |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | The corrected time charge |
| No | Yes | The final time charge less the billing-error credits |
| No | No | The final time charge |

## Hypothetical cases

- Final time charge 400.00 USD, no corrected time charge, a billing-error credit of 56.08 USD: the discount base is 343.92 USD.
- Final time charge 400.00 USD and a corrected time charge of 330.00 USD, with a billing-error credit also standing: the corrected time charge is present, so the discount base is 330.00 USD.
- Final time charge 400.00 USD and nothing else: the discount base is 400.00 USD.
